children: The company notified Nasdaq of its voluntary withdrawal of listing for its ADSs in connection with the Scheme of Arrangement and requested suspension of trading before the market open on September 9, 2026, with Nasdaq to file Form 25 to delist and deregister the ADSs. Following effectiveness, no ADSs remain outstanding and there is no public trading market for the ADSs. The company also intends to file Form 15 to suspend its SEC reporting obligations.
